blocks.jsonl: mainnet blocks from https://rpc.tempo.xyz and one testnet block from https://rpc.moderato.tempo.xyz, fetched 2026-11-17 with goempo-dev fetch: debug_getRawBlock (raw), eth_getBlockByNumber (hash, roots, tx hash/from), eth_getBlockReceipts (type, status, cumulativeGasUsed, logs, feePayer). The smallest cached block for each transaction and signature variant.
txs.jsonl: one transaction envelope per variant (legacy, system, 1559, 7702, 0x76 with secp256k1, p256, webauthn, keychain v1/v2, fee payer, key authorization, AA authorization list), cut from blocks of the same two RPCs on 2026-11-17, with the RPC's hash, from, receipt feePayer and keychain keyId.
